messages:
Ivy (PM): quick sync — need decision on seat-based per-route entitlements vs org-level buckets for the new 'microcommit' packaging
Rohan (Sales): field: customers love per-route controls for compliance (separate teams) but procurement prefers one invoice line
Dina (Eng): technical tradeoff: per-route seats = mapping + enforcement on request headers; org-bucket is cheaper to enforce. estimate: 3 sprints for per-route, 1 sprint for org-bucket
Sam (Finance): revenue side: per-route SKUs let us upsell teams separately. drawback: many small lines complicate ARR reporting. prefer hybrid: parent SKU + optional route-seat addons
Derek (Legal): contracts: per-route seats could create sub-tenant obligations. need clarified liability and data segmentation language in MSA addendum
pricing-bot: uploaded draft pricebook: /pricing/drafts/seat-route-2026-03-23.json
Ivy (PM): hybrid proposal: parent "microcommit" SKU (monthly base) includes N org tokens + M free seats; additional route-seat addon available as fixed monthly line. GA gating: billing mapping, seat enforcement, legal addendum, 2 pilots
Rohan (Sales): pilot ask: allow sales to quote "route-seat block" (1,3,10) as single PO line. sales-ops needs CSV export per-route for chargeback
Dina (Eng): enforcement semantics question: if a route-seat is exhausted, should we reject or queue to org-bucket?
Ivy (PM): prefer fallback: consume org-bucket if route-seat exhausted, but surface warnings and throttle if both depleted
Dina (Eng): proto config below for enforcement:
```
packaging:
  microcommit:
    base_price: 199
    base_tokens: 200000
    included_route_seats: 2
  route_seat_addon:
    block_sizes: [1,3,10]
    price_per_block: [29,79,249]
    enforcement: fallback_to_org_bucket
    alert_threshold: 0.8
```
Sam (Finance): pricing comment: price blocks should give clear uplift vs org-bucket. I'll model conversion curves and churn risk and post numbers by EOD
Derek (Legal): will draft addendum that clarifies seat assignment, sub-accounting, and auditing rights for partners/pilots
pricing-bot: billing-rule applied to sandbox org for pilot flows
Rohan (Sales): lining up pilots: FinApp (multi-team) + EduCloud (district). will send contact details by Tue
Ivy (PM): launch checklist (short): billing product entries, sample PO lines, legal addendum, telemetry per-route and per-seat, 2 pilots instrumented 4 weeks
Dina (Eng): eng estimates: per-route mapping + enforcement = 3 sprints, billing hook + exports = 1 sprint, telemetry = 1 sprint
Ivy (PM): decision: proceed with hybrid pilot (parent SKU + route-seat blocks). GA deferred until pilot validates quoting simplicity and billing exports. No public launch of per-route-only SKU yet
Sam (Finance): will post ARR scenarios and recommended block prices by EOD
Derek (Legal): will share draft language in #legal-drafts tomorrow for review
Ivy (PM): thanks all — assigning PRO ticket and follow-ups. end
